What it does

Attack speed, within the attack speed cap: 5%. Goes on a weapon. On a wand: Spell cooldowns (not the global cooldown). Lasts 500 kills that pay you XP.

Dropped by monsters of level 49 and up. About augments. Placeholder: which monsters give which kind is still unknown.
